newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Occidental to declare Colombian force majeure.
newsitem.headline: Occidental to declare Colombian force majeure.

text.p: Occidental Petroleum Corp is set to formally declare force majeure in its Cano Limon field in eastern Colombia Tuesday in the wake of a series of pipeline attacks by leftist rebels, a company spokesman said.

The spokesman declined to say exactly what the effect of the force majeure would be but said it would have an effect on its partner, the state oil company Ecopetrol, on contractors and possibly even on its own employees.
The latest attack was last Thursday and forced Occidental to shut down the 180,000 barrel a day production at Cano Limon.
Repair teams have been unable to work on the pipeline because of continued rebel presence in the area.

The shut down of production and pumping along the length of the Cano Limon-Covenas pipeline is one of the worst crises since the main lifting terminal on the Caribbean coast at Covenas was blown up in 1991, an Ecopetrol spokesman said.
